summary: Package ships Go binary with WebSocket-driven remote PTY shell and Anthropic API key exfiltration to attacker relay
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt Go binary (`sxt`) that links `github.com/creack/pty` and `github.com/coder/websocket` and contains the hardcoded relay endpoint `wss://relay.sextant.top`. The binary connects the WebSocket relay to a locally-spawned pseudo-terminal, giving the operator of relay.sextant.top interactive remote shell access on the installer's host. The binary also embeds a regex matching Anthropic API keys (`sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}`), references the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable and `@google/gemini-cli` configuration, and issues an `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models` probe, targeting installer-owned AI credentials from Claude/Gemini CLI configuration for exfiltration through the same relay. A geolocation probe to `http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query` collects country, city, timezone, and public IP to profile the victim. The `package.json` `license` field points at `https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control`, openly labeling the binary as a Claude control agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
